info.title: OpenPay API
info.description: OpenPay is a opensource payment service

post.description: Product backend only. Verified with the provider before it can receive money.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
AddBeneficiaryRequest registers a destination, verified with the provider
(penny drop / VPA lookup) before it can receive money.

get.description: Never returns secrets. Requires the openpay:credentials:write permission.

post.description: Returns the secret in clear text exactly once; it is stored only as a hash and cannot be recovered. Requires the openpay:credentials:write permission.
Takes effect immediately. Revoking an already-revoked credential succeeds. Requires the openpay:credentials:write permission.
Called by a product's backend with a service credential. Idempotent on external_ref, and resolves through a merge if the person's record was merged into another.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
UpsertCustomerRequest registers a person, or returns the existing record.
Called by a product's backend the first time one of its users transacts.

get.description: Product backend, or an operator holding openpay:withdrawals:read.
A product backend sees its own product's wallets and platform-scoped ones — never another product's. An operator sees their scope; platform wallets need openpay:scope:all.
Accepts an OpenPay customer id or an OpenAuth external ref. Callable by a product backend or by an operator holding openpay:customers:read.
The disputes queue, nearest evidence deadline first. Requires openpay:payments:read within scope.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
- DISPUTE_STATUS_OPEN: Awaiting our evidence.
 - DISPUTE_STATUS_UNDER_REVIEW: Evidence submitted; the network is deciding.

get.description: Requires openpay:payments:read within scope.

post.description: Only while the dispute is open. Central ops only: requires openpay:disputes:manage and openpay:scope:all.

get.summary: Get the real customer money held
get.description: Balances of fundable wallets only, per product, with platform-scoped wallets as their own line. Requires openpay:wallets:read; platform lines need openpay:scope:all.
Product backend only.

post.summary: Add an item to the product's catalogue
post.description: Product backend only. The catalogue describes; orders carry what was actually charged.

get.description: Filter by product, platform-only, type or code prefix. Requires the openpay:ledger:read permission.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Only this product's accounts.

parameters.name: platformOnly
parameters.description: Only accounts belonging to no product. Cannot be combined with product_id.

parameters.name: codePrefix
parameters.description: Prefix of the account code, e.g. "psp:" or "income:zshala:".

get.description: Postings newest first, each with the running balance after it. Cursor-paginated, so a page never shifts when new postings arrive. Requires the openpay:ledger:read permission.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: An account id or code, as for GetLedgerAccount.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Empty for the newest entries.

get.summary: Get a ledger account and its balance
get.description: Accepts an account id or an account code. Requires the openpay:ledger:read permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An account id (acc_…) or an account code (anything containing ':').

get.description: Scheduled and manual runs, newest first. Requires the openpay:ledger:read permission.

post.summary: Run the ledger invariant checks now
post.description: Checks every invariant against one consistent snapshot and records the run. Reports drift; never fixes it. Requires the openpay:ledger:check permission. Takes no idempotency key: it moves no money, and running it twice is harmless.

get.summary: Get a journal and its postings
get.description: Accepts a journal id or its external id. Requires the openpay:ledger:read permission.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A journal id (jrn_…) or its external id (anything containing ':').

get.description: Every account's debits, credits and balance, computed from postings, optionally as of a past moment and for one product. Platform-wide debits and credits must be equal. Requires the openpay:ledger:read permission.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: Only this product's accounts. Empty for the whole platform.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Balances as they stood at this moment. Empty for now.

parameters.name: includeEmpty
parameters.description: Include accounts that have never been posted to.

post.summary: Create and pay for an order
post.description: Product backend only. Checks the amounts add up, then settles from wallets at once, or holds the wallet shares and returns a checkout for the card share. Requires an Idempotency-Key; also idempotent on external_ref.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
CreateOrderRequest records a purchase and starts paying for it. Called by
a product backend with an Idempotency-Key; also idempotent on external_ref.

get.description: Product backend for its own orders, or an operator holding openpay:payments:read within scope.

post.description: Product backend for its own orders. Cancels the card checkout and releases held wallet shares. If the customer paid first, the order is settled instead and this is refused.

Returns part or all of a paid order with its own tax split, real money first: card, then purchased wallets, then granted ones. Product backend for its own orders, or central ops with openpay:refunds:create. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Operator only, within scope. Requires openpay:payments:read.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: - PAYMENT_STATUS_PENDING: Waiting for the customer at the provider's checkout.

post.description: Product backend only. Returns the checkout to send the customer to. Requires an Idempotency-Key. Wallet top-ups only until orders exist.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
CreatePaymentRequest starts collecting money. Called by a product backend
with an Idempotency-Key: a retry returns the same payment and checkout.

get.description: Product backend for its own payments, or an operator holding openpay:payments:read; operators also see attempts and the transition history.

post.summary: Sync a payment with its provider now
post.description: Fetches the provider's state and applies it, as the poller would. Requires openpay:payments:sync.

get.description: Requires openpay:payments:read within scope.

post.description: Returns part or all of a captured payment to its source. A wallet top-up can only be refunded while its value is still in the wallet. Central ops only: requires openpay:refunds:create and openpay:scope:all, an explained reason code, and an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Requires the openpay:products:read permission.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches code or name, case-insensitively.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
- PRODUCT_STATUS_SUSPENDED: Suspended stops new activity. Products are never deleted: money has moved
against them and the ledger must stay interpretable.

post.description: Registers a product. The code is immutable once set because ledger account codes embed it. Requires the openpay:products:write permission and an Idempotency-Key header.

get.description: Requires the openpay:products:read permission.

patch.description: Changes name and status only. Code and currency are immutable. Requires the openpay:products:write permission.

get.description: The work queue, oldest first. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:read and openpay:scope:all.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Empty for every status.

post.description: Explain, force-match to a payment, or write off — reason-coded, explained, audited, and a journal whenever money moves. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:manage and openpay:scope:all.
Ingests new settlements, flags unsettled payments, and returns the summary. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:manage and openpay:scope:all.

get.description: Fees charged to customers against fees paid to providers over a period. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:read and openpay:scope:all.
Open and aged breaks, suspense and receivable per provider. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:read and openpay:scope:all.
Requires openpay:payments:read within scope.
Newest first. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:read and openpay:scope:all.
Every line with how it matched, and the credit split by product. Central ops: requires openpay:recon:read and openpay:scope:all.
Includes platform-scoped types, which are spendable in every product. Requires the openpay:wallet_types:read permission.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description:
The product whose wallet types to list. Platform-scoped types are always
included, since they are spendable there too.

post.description: Requires the openpay:wallet_types:write permission. Enabling withdrawable additionally requires openpay:wallet_types:approve_withdrawal and an approval reference, because it moves the balance from closed-loop into prepaid-instrument territory.

get.description: Requires the openpay:wallet_types:read permission.

patch.description: Changes name, status and limits only. Currency, scope and every capability are immutable once the type exists, because balances are already held under those rules.

post.description: Returns the customer's wallet of a type, creating it on first reference. Product backend only. Naturally idempotent; no Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
OpenWallet returns a customer's wallet of a type, creating it on first
reference. Called by a product backend. Naturally idempotent on (customer,
type), so it takes no Idempotency-Key.

post.description: Between wallets of the same, transferable type. Product backend only. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Get a wallet and its balance
get.description: Product backend, or an operator holding openpay:wallets:read.

post.description: Operator correction against the product's adjustments expense, reason-coded and explained. Bypasses capability and limit rules but never permits an overdraft. Requires openpay:wallets:adjust and openpay:scope:all, and an Idempotency-Key.
Grantable wallet types only, funded by the product's promotions expense and reason-coded. Requires an Idempotency-Key. Product backend, or an operator holding openpay:wallets:grant.

get.description: Newest first, cursor-paginated, each line with its change and running balance.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page. Empty for the newest entries.

get.description: Filter by status for the approval queue. Operator holding openpay:withdrawals:read within scope.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL gives the approval queue.

 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL: Above the wallet type's threshold: waiting for an approver.
 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_APPROVED: Cleared to send; the provider has not yet confirmed it.
 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_FAILED: Never left; the money is back in the wallet.
 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_REVERSED: Left, then bounced; the money is back in the wallet.

post.description: Product backend only. Refused below the wallet type's minimum; above its approval threshold it waits for an approver. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
RequestWithdrawalRequest takes the amount out of the wallet at once. Up to
the wallet type's approval threshold it is sent immediately; above it, it
waits for approval. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Product backend for its own, or an operator holding openpay:withdrawals:read within scope.

post.description: Central ops: requires openpay:withdrawals:approve and openpay:scope:all. The approver cannot be whoever requested it.
Returns the money to the wallet. Central ops: requires openpay:withdrawals:approve and openpay:scope:all.

direction.description: CREDIT adds value to the wallet; DEBIT removes it.

memo.description: Required: an adjustment nobody explained cannot be audited.

productId.description: Whose adjustments account funds it, for a platform-scoped wallet.

note.description: Why. Required: a decision nobody explained cannot be audited.

reasonCode.description: customer_request, duplicate_payment, fraud, service_issue or unapplied_payment.

OpenPayCreateRefundBody.description:
CreateRefundRequest returns part or all of a captured payment to the card or
bank it came from. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

reasonCode.description: promotion, referral, cashback, loyalty or compensation.

fundingProductId.description:
Whose promotions budget pays, for a platform-scoped wallet. Ignored for a
product wallet (its own product pays) and for a product backend (the
caller's product pays).

taxBreakdownProvided.description: The refund's own split. Leave false to have it split proportionally.

note.description: Why. Required: a decision nobody explained cannot be audited.

reasonCode.description: provider_error, reference_mismatch, timing, bank_adjustment, unrecoverable or other.

note.description: What was found. Required: a decision nobody explained cannot be audited.

evidence.title: What answers the chargeback: delivery proof, the refund already made, …

OpenPaySyncPaymentBody.description:
SyncPaymentRequest asks the provider for a payment's state now, rather than
waiting for a webhook or the poller.

toCustomerId.description: The recipient's wallet of the same type is opened if they have none.

OpenPayUpdateWalletTypeBody.description:
UpdateWalletTypeRequest carries only what stays safe to change once wallets
exist. Currency, scope and capabilities are absent on purpose: a balance
already held under one set of rules must not have them rewritten underneath
it.

v1AddBeneficiaryRequest.description:
AddBeneficiaryRequest registers a destination, verified with the provider
(penny drop / VPA lookup) before it can receive money.

accountNumberMasked.description: Only the last four digits are ever returned.

nameAtBank.description: The name the bank or UPI directory reports, to check against name.

v1BreakAction.description:
- BREAK_ACTION_RESOLVE: Explain it. Only for a break with nothing in suspense.
 - BREAK_ACTION_FORCE_MATCH: Attribute its money to a payment (payment_id): suspense → receivable.
 - BREAK_ACTION_WRITE_OFF: Give up on its money: suspense (or receivable) → write-offs.

customerId.description: Optional for a card-only guest purchase; required to pay from wallets.

taxBreakdownProvided.description:
With tax_breakdown_provided, subtotal - discount + tax must equal total.
Without it, send only total: it is booked gross and flagged.

lines.description: If given, they must sum to the subtotal.

walletTenders.description:
Explicit wallet shares. Or auto_tender: draw from the customer's wallets,
granted value first. A card pays whatever remains.

v1CreateOrderRequest.description:
CreateOrderRequest records a purchase and starts paying for it. Called by
a product backend with an Idempotency-Key; also idempotent on external_ref.

walletId.description: For WALLET_TOPUP: the wallet to credit, which fixes the customer too.

description.description: On the customer's statement; the product name is prefixed.

returnUrl.description: Where the provider sends the customer afterwards.

v1CreatePaymentRequest.description:
CreatePaymentRequest starts collecting money. Called by a product backend
with an Idempotency-Key: a retry returns the same payment and checkout.

code.description:
Immutable once set: it appears inside ledger account codes such as
income:zshala:product_sales, so changing it would orphan them.

defaultCurrency.description:
INR only for v1. Also immutable: a product with balances behind it cannot
change currency without making its own history unreadable.

secret.description:
The secret, in clear text, returned exactly once. It is stored only as a
hash, so it cannot be recovered later — if it is lost, issue a new
credential and revoke this one.

Present the credential to OpenPay as: Authorization: Bearer <key_id>.<secret>

productId.description: Leave empty to create a platform-scoped type spendable everywhere.

expiryDays.description: Required when expiry_policy is not NONE, and rejected when it is.

withdrawalApprovalRef.description:
Required when capabilities.withdrawable is set: the compliance sign-off
this configuration rests on.

v1Customer.description:
Customer is a person, not a per-product record: every product identifies
people by the same OpenAuth user id, so one customer covers them everywhere.

v1CustomerStatus.description:
- CUSTOMER_STATUS_MERGED: A duplicate that now resolves to another record. Lookups follow it, so an
id stored before a merge keeps working.

fromWallet.description:
Where the held money came from. from_expense is what the customer had
already spent: our loss unless the dispute is won.

v1Dispute.description:
A chargeback: the customer's bank taking a payment back. Opened by the bank,
never by us; while it is decided, the contested money is held out of the
customer's wallet.

v1DisputeStatus.description:
- DISPUTE_STATUS_OPEN: Awaiting our evidence.
 - DISPUTE_STATUS_UNDER_REVIEW: Evidence submitted; the network is deciding.

v1ExpiryPolicy.description:
- EXPIRY_POLICY_FIXED: Expires a fixed period after the balance was credited.
 - EXPIRY_POLICY_ROLLING: Pushes expiry out on every use.

cost.description: expense:<product>:psp_fees — what those payments actually cost.

variance.description: charged - cost. Persistently one-sided means the rate card is wrong.

productId.description: Empty for platform-scoped wallets, which belong to no one product.

v1FloatHeldLine.description:
FloatHeld is the real customer money held — the balance of fundable
wallets only; granted value is excluded because nobody paid for it.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next, older page. Empty on the last page.

entries.description: Newest first; change is positive when the wallet grew.

referencePrice.description: For description and reporting only; an order carries what was charged.

taxClass.description: A reporting label, e.g. gst_18. Never used to compute anything.

reversesJournalId.description: The journal this one reverses, if it is a correction.

productId.description: Empty for platform accounts, which belong to no product.

balance.description: What the account holds, in its natural direction.

held.description: Reserved by active holds and not yet posted.

available.description: balance - held: what can still be spent.

subject.description: What it concerns: an account code, journal external id, or currency.

triggeredBy.description: Who asked, for a manual run.

truncated.description: Set when the findings list was cut short; the ledger has more.

v1LedgerCheckStatus.description:
- LEDGER_CHECK_STATUS_OK: Every invariant held.
 - LEDGER_CHECK_STATUS_DRIFT: At least one invariant was broken. Never fixed automatically.
 - LEDGER_CHECK_STATUS_ERROR: The check itself could not complete, so nothing is known.

total.description: Size of the whole filtered set, not of this page.
Size of the whole filtered set, not of this page.

walletTypeCode.description: The caller's own product's type, or a platform-scoped type.

v1OpenWalletRequest.description:
OpenWallet returns a customer's wallet of a type, creating it on first
reference. Called by a product backend. Naturally idempotent on (customer,
type), so it takes no Idempotency-Key.

created.description: False when the wallet already existed.

taxBreakdownProvided.description: False when the product sent a bare total: booked gross, flagged here.

gatewayAmount.description: The card share, and where to send the customer to pay it.

itemId.description: Optional: a catalogue item of this product.

v1OrderRefund.description:
An order refund carries its own tax split (plan.md D13). Without one, the
split is proportional to the order's and tax_breakdown_provided is false.

refundId.description: …or returned to the card through this payment refund.

v1OrderRefundPart.description: How much of a refund went back through one tender, and where.

v1OrderStatus.description: - ORDER_STATUS_PENDING_PAYMENT: Waiting for the card share; wallet shares are held.

checkoutUrl.description: Where to send the customer to pay, while the payment is pending.

failureCode.description: Canonical: declined, insufficient_funds, risk or technical.

attempts.description: Operator views only: every try and every state change, with its cause.

refundedAmount.description: Promised back so far: refunds initiated, pending or processed.

v1PaymentApplication.description:
Where captured money went in the ledger.

 - PAYMENT_APPLICATION_PENDING: Not captured yet.
 - PAYMENT_APPLICATION_APPLIED: Credited to its purpose.
 - PAYMENT_APPLICATION_UNAPPLIED: The purpose refused it (e.g. a wallet limit); owed back to the customer.
 - PAYMENT_APPLICATION_SUSPENSE: The provider's amount disagreed with ours; held for review.

v1PaymentPurpose.description: - PAYMENT_PURPOSE_ORDER: Paying for an order. Available with orders (plan.md phase 7).

v1PaymentStatus.description: - PAYMENT_STATUS_PENDING: Waiting for the customer at the provider's checkout.

source.description: api, webhook, poller, sweeper or operator.

refundDestination.description:
Where an order refund goes unless the refund says otherwise: "source"
(back to how it was paid) or "wallet" (store credit).

v1Product.description:
Product is one of our own apps. It is the scoping dimension for wallets,
orders and revenue.

v1ProductStatus.description:
- PRODUCT_STATUS_SUSPENDED: Suspended stops new activity. Products are never deleted: money has moved
against them and the ledger must stay interpretable.

agedBreaks.description: Open breaks past the age threshold: anything here needs a person.

suspense.description:
Per provider. Suspense should trend to zero; a receivable that only
grows means settlements are not arriving.

source.description:
wallet: taken from the customer's wallet. unapplied: from money the
wallet had refused, already owed back.

v1RefundStatus.description: - REFUND_STATUS_INITIATED: Money reserved; the provider has not yet confirmed it has the request.

v1RequestWithdrawalRequest.description:
RequestWithdrawalRequest takes the amount out of the wallet at once. Up to
the wallet type's approval threshold it is sent immediately; above it, it
waits for approval. Requires an Idempotency-Key.

keyId.description: The public half, safe to display and to log.

lastUsedAt.description: Answers "is anyone still using this key?" before revoking it.

v1ServiceCredential.description:
ServiceCredential is how a product's backend authenticates. It never carries
the secret: that exists only in the response to CreateServiceCredential.

expected.description: What the ledger expected, and what did not match it (held in suspense).

classification.description: matched, missing_in_ledger, amount_mismatch, fee_mismatch or duplicate.

productId.description: Empty for lines that matched nothing.

v1SettlementProductShare.description: Of one bank credit, which product earned what.

change.description: Effect on this account's natural balance: positive when it grew.

balanceAfter.description: The account's natural balance immediately after this posting.

v1StatementEntry.description:
One line of an account statement: a posting, with enough of its journal to
say why the money moved.

balance.description: The balance in the account's natural direction.

difference.description:
For the whole platform this must be zero. For one product it generally is
not: the other side of its revenue sits in platform accounts.

v1UpsertCustomerRequest.description:
UpsertCustomerRequest registers a person, or returns the existing record.
Called by a product's backend the first time one of its users transacts.

created.description:
False when the customer already existed, which lets a caller tell a first
registration from a repeat without a second lookup.

productId.description: Empty for a platform-scoped wallet, spendable in every product.

fundable.description: May be topped up with real money.

grantable.description: May be credited without payment, as a promotion.

withdrawable.description:
May be cashed out to a bank. Requires an approval reference: enabling this
moves the company from closed-loop into prepaid-instrument territory.

transferable.description: May be transferred to another customer.

allowNegative.description: May go negative. Off unless a product genuinely needs overdraft.

v1WalletCapabilities.description:
WalletCapabilities is what a balance of this type is allowed to do.

fundable and grantable are deliberately separate. Money a customer paid for
is a real liability; a promotional coin we issued is funded from marketing
spend, expires, and should never be cashable. Mixing them in one balance
permanently loses the answer to "how much real customer money do we hold?".

minWithdrawalAmount.description:
Withdrawal policy, for withdrawable types only (rejected otherwise).
The smallest withdrawal accepted; smaller requests are refused.

withdrawalApprovalThreshold.description:
Withdrawals up to this amount are paid out automatically; larger ones
wait for an approver other than the requester. Zero: none need approval.

v1WalletLimits.description: WalletLimits are in minor units. Zero means no limit.

v1WalletScope.description:
- WALLET_SCOPE_PRODUCT: Confined to one product.
 - WALLET_SCOPE_PLATFORM: Spendable across every product — possible only because this is a
single-tenant estate.

v1WalletStatus.description: - WALLET_STATUS_FROZEN: Customer-initiated movement is refused while support investigates.

v1WalletTypeStatus.description:
- WALLET_TYPE_STATUS_ARCHIVED: Stops new wallets being created. Existing ones keep working: they hold
real balances.

v1WithdrawalApproval.description: WithdrawalApproval records who signed off on enabling withdrawal.

v1WithdrawalStatus.description:
- WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_PENDING_APPROVAL: Above the wallet type's threshold: waiting for an approver.
 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_APPROVED: Cleared to send; the provider has not yet confirmed it.
 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_FAILED: Never left; the money is back in the wallet.
 - WITHDRAWAL_STATUS_REVERSED: Left, then bounced; the money is back in the wallet.

UserPerms.description: Comma-separated permissions of the authenticated user
UserPerms.name: x-user-perms
